chunks: And it has been narrated from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) that he said:
Do you not deny that Allah will prolong the lifespan of the Master of this affair, just as He prolonged the lifespan of Nuh (peace be upon him)?

key_terms.صَاحِبُ الْأَمْرِ: Master of the Command (referring to the Imam)

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the Imam's long lifespan in Shia theology?
ai.summary: In this narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba*, Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (a.s.) addresses the companions' potential skepticism regarding the Mahdi's prolonged lifespan by comparing it to Prophet Nuh (a.s.), whose longevity is explicitly mentioned in the Quran. This comparison serves to validate the concept of *Tawqif* (divine decree) for the Imam's life, reinforcing the Shia belief in the Occultation as a period of divine preservation rather than absence. The reference to Nuh underscores that such extended lifespans are within Allah's power and have precedent in prophetic history.
